title: 第2116章 让它们最后一程走的香香的第2115章 你楚星河为什么就抓住我一个人坑
slug: 我只想毁灭宗门咋逆天成神了
lines: 欧阳明进入昊天圣地之前名气就很大……名气主要集中在坑蒙拐骗上面！
可是也没办法，当年的欧阳明身为欧阳家的家主，无论是妹妹欧阳玲，还是家里的其他人，欧阳明都要保证他们活着。
欧阳明是一个狠人，在那种环境下，欧阳明但凡要一点儿脸，可能欧阳家都等不到进入昊天圣地就灭了！
所以欧阳明的选择没有错，人在什么环境下就应该做出什么样的选择。
后来欧阳明进入昊天圣地，全烈阳大陆都认为这一把欧阳明还不得把当时的昊天宗坑尿啊！
可是欧阳明却用事实告诉了全烈阳大陆的人，有时候成功比想象来的还要更快！
而后欧阳明更是一路走到神师，号称四洲有史以来最强炼器神师。
可是名头是名头，欧阳明在外面的口碑却始终一般。
没办法……你想象一下，当年欧阳明带着全家要饭的时候，连特么家族的工具都卖了！
后来还是楚星河帮忙赎回来的。
而现在各方的炼器大师，他们大概就是那些曾经在欧阳明要饭的时候把欧阳明当成一条狗一样来施舍和玩乐的那群人！
现在你让这样的一群人去接受他们曾经内心无比看不起的欧阳明无敌了？
这谁能接受？
所以即便欧阳明名气再大，你瞅瞅私下里那些炼器大师们是怎么议论欧阳明的？
什么欧阳明只不过是运气好，被楚星河选中了而已！
欧阳明既然炼器之术如此无敌，为何不出来让大家开开眼界？
甚至还有人认为欧阳明有什么真本事？不过就是靠传承呗？
所以私下里即便欧阳明再怎么牛逼，这些人内心都是不服气的。
毕竟在他们的眼中，欧阳明可能永远都是那个要饭的，一个要饭的凭什么比我们都强？
他配吗？
没办法，自从欧阳明进入昊天圣地以来，你说欧阳明懒吧，他天天哐哧哐哧的给师兄弟给长老们各种打造神兵利器。
只要有需要的找到欧阳明，欧阳明最多要求你去安排几盆冷面，除此之外，昊天圣地谁找欧阳明，欧阳明都肯定给你安排的明明白白的。
可是你要说欧阳明勤奋吧，从欧阳明成名到今天，他几乎没有怎么出过昊天圣地。
面对各方的邀请，欧阳明从来都是俩字儿——不去！
而欧阳明之所以会有这样的表现其实也跟他早年的经历有关。
欧阳家鼎盛时期，人人都看着欧阳家的脸色说话。
欧阳家没落的时代，所有人眼中他欧阳家的人连条狗都不如。
那些曾经跟欧阳家沾亲带故的，在欧阳家最绝望的时候甚至连一片立锥之地都不肯给欧阳家。
所以欧阳明成名之后，外界来找欧阳明打造的，除非拿出欧阳锤，否则欧阳明绝对不能帮任何人打造。
这是欧阳明的规矩！
也正是因为欧阳明甚少离开昊天圣地，所以这一来二去的欧阳明只存在于传说之中，甚至都没有多少人亲眼见到过欧阳明。
这种情况下就给了四洲所有人一个错觉，那些人说的不会是真的吧，欧阳明就是单纯因为运气好？
对于这件事，欧阳明倒是不怎么在乎，可是欧阳明表示自己不在乎，但星河师兄在乎！

Ouyang Ming was very famous before he entered Haotian Holy Land...his fame was mainly focused on deceit and abduction!
But there was nothing that could be done. As the head of the Ouyang family back then, Ouyang Ming had to ensure that their sister Ouyang Ling or other members of the family were alive.
Ouyang Ming is a ruthless person. In that kind of environment, if Ouyang Ming shows any dignity, the Ouyang family may be destroyed before they even enter the Haotian Holy Land!
Therefore, Ouyang Ming's choice was not wrong. People should make the choice they want under any circumstances.
Later, when Ouyang Ming entered the Holy Land of Haotian, the whole Lieyang Continent thought that Ouyang Ming could not make the Haotian Sect piss off at that time!
But Ouyang Ming used facts to tell everyone in Lieyang Continent that sometimes success comes faster than imagined!
Then Ouyang Ming went all the way to become a divine master, claiming to be the most powerful weapon-refining master in the history of the Four Continents.
But a name is a name, and Ouyang Ming's reputation outside has always been average.
There's no way... Just imagine, when Ouyang Ming took his whole family to beg for food, he even sold the family's tools!
Later, Chu Xinghe helped redeem it.
As for the current weapon-refining masters from all parties, they are probably the same group of people who once treated Ouyang Ming like a dog to give alms and have fun when Ouyang Ming was begging for food!
Now you want such a group of people to accept Ouyang Ming's invincibility, which they once despised in their hearts?
Who can accept this?
So no matter how famous Ouyang Ming is, take a look at what the masters of weapon refining talk about Ouyang Ming in private?
Ouyang Ming was just lucky enough to be chosen by Chu Xinghe!
Since Ou Yangming is so invincible in the art of refining weapons, why doesn't he come out and let everyone open their eyes?
Some people even think that Ouyang Ming has any real abilities? Just relying on inheritance?
So in private, no matter how awesome Ouyang Ming is, these people are still unconvinced.
After all, in their eyes, Ouyang Ming may always be the beggar. How can a beggar be better than us?
Is he worthy?
There is no way. Ever since Ouyang Ming entered Haotian Holy Land, you can call Ouyang Ming lazy. He has been making all kinds of magical weapons for his brothers and elders every day.
As long as you find Ouyang Ming in need, Ouyang Ming will ask you to arrange a few pots of cold noodles at most. In addition, Ouyang Ming will definitely arrange it for you if you ask for it in Haotian Holy Land.
But you have to say that Ouyang Ming is diligent. From the time Ouyang Ming became famous to today, he has hardly been out of Haotian Holy Land.
When faced with invitations from various parties, Ouyang Ming always had one word - I won't go!
The reason why Ouyang Ming behaves like this is actually related to his early experiences.
During the Ouyang family's heyday, everyone looked at the Ouyang family's face and spoke.
In the era of the decline of the Ouyang family, everyone in the Ouyang family regarded him as worse than a dog.
Those who were once related to the Ouyang family refused to even give the Ouyang family a piece of land when they were at their most desperate.
So after Ouyang Ming became famous, outsiders came to Ouyang Ming to build it. Unless he took out Ouyang Hammer, Ouyang Ming would never help anyone build it.
This is Ouyang Ming's rule!
It is precisely because Ouyang Ming rarely leaves Haotian Holy Land that Ouyang Ming only exists in legends, and not many people have even seen Ouyang Ming with their own eyes.
This situation gave everyone in the Four Continents an illusion. What those people said could not be true. Is Ouyang Ming just because of his luck?
Ouyang Ming didn't care much about this matter, but Ouyang Ming said that he didn't care, but Senior Brother Xinghe did!
